prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a middle-aged man in a black suit and white dress shirt, his face contorted in intense anguish and despair. His mouth is open in a silent cry, deep wrinkles etched across his forehead and around his eyes, emphasizing the raw emotion. His hair is neatly combed to the side, but slightly disheveled, adding to the sense of distress. Behind him, two other men in similar black suits and ties are partially visible, their faces blurred and out of focus, suggesting a shallow depth of field that isolates the main subject. The background is bright and overexposed, creating a stark contrast with the dark suits and drawing all attention to the central figure’s expression. The color palette is muted and cool, dominated by blacks, whites, and pale skin tones, with natural lighting that highlights the textures and lines of the man’s face. The overall style is cinematic and dramatic, reminiscent of a pivotal emotional moment in a film, with the camera positioned at eye level to capture the immediacy and vulnerability of the scene.
